messages.author: 39f0839e8d6a4470
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Re: Error messge in SurveyDesign
parts:
Hi Adrian,

"the database engine couldn´t lock table ´Grid´because it´s already in use by another person or process..." .sounds like either part of Distance or another application was already accessing/updating the database.

Not sure what is going wrong with the other design... my first thought is a shapefile issue, particularly with that strata layer although it is strange that it works on a different machine if they are identical shapefiles. Shapefiles can sometimes get corrupted quite easily. When you run the design in the whole study area it will be using a different shapefile to when you try to create the stratified design. Perhaps you can try re-creating the strata layer?

If that still fails can you send me the project as a .zip file please. You can remove the .zip part so it gets through.

Thanks,

Laura


 
Dr. L. Marshall
Centre for Research into Ecological and Environmental Modelling
University of St. Andrews
